stories.title: Mumbai water cut: BMC announces 24-hour supply disruption on November 26-27
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has announced a 24-hour water supply disruption in several parts of Mumbai on November 26 and 27 due to scheduled repairs to major water pipelines between Powai High-Level Reservoir No. 1 (PHLR-1) and Sahar Village. According to the civic body, repair work will begin at 9 am on Thursday, November 26, and continue until 9 am on Friday, November 27, 2026.

stories.title: Mumbai Police’s new drug-testing van catches 12 concertgoers 2 days after launch
stories.summary: As thousands of music lovers made their way out of Mahalaxmi Racecourse for Anyma’s Aeden World Tour on Sunday, some concertgoers found themselves being stopped by Mumbai Police and asked to undergo an unusual check – an oral swab test to detect drug consumption.

stories.title: FDA fines Mumbai University canteen Rs 1 lakh for operating without food licence
stories.summary: The canteen operating at Mumbai University’s Fort campus has been fined R1 lakh after it was found to be operating without a valid food licence and multiple food safety and hygiene violations following an inspection by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on November 22-23. Officials found several lapses, including food handlers working without prescribed uniforms and protective clothing.

stories.title: ED attaches assets worth ₹556 cr in investment fraud
stories.summary: 72 crore, including in Mumbai, as part of its money laundering investigation into an investment fraud, where ₹ 8,852 crore was collected from the public on the pretext of long-term holiday membership and investment schemes with attractive returns. The fraud was carried out during 2008 to 2017 by firms including Royal Twinkle Star Club Limited (RTSCL), Citrus Check Inns Limited (CCIL) and their associated entities, ED officials said on Monday.

stories.title: Horror unfolds at Navi Mumbai court, life convict jumps to death moments after sentencing
stories.summary: In a shocking turn of events at a court in Thane district on Monday, a 28-year-old convict jumped to his death from the building’s fifth floor, minutes after being sentenced to life imprisonment for murdering his sister in 2019 and 10 years of rigorous imprisonment for attempting to murder his wife.

stories.title: BEST to audit wet-lease buses as costs, safety concerns mount; Mumbai needs 13,000 buses: BEST general manager
stories.summary: BEST will conduct a performance audit of its wet-lease buses and review existing contracts after concerns that the model is costing the undertaking more than it earns while also throwing up operational and road-safety issues, general manager Sonia Sethi said during a meeting to clear a Rs 1,317 crore deficit budget on Monday.

stories.title: Maharashtra: 2 Killed, 27 Injured After Private Bus Overturns On Samruddhi Mahamarg Expressway
stories.summary: According to news agency PTI , the accident occurred at around 1 pm within the jurisdiction of the Phulambri police station in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar district, an official said. The private bus, which had originated from Nagpur, rammed into the parapet wall along the expressway before overturning, the official was quoted as saying.

stories.title: `I was a Pakistani actor shooting in India during 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks`: Ali Zafar
stories.summary: Pakistani actor and singer Ali Zafar made his Bollywood debut with Tere Bin Laden in 2010. Recalling his experience, he described the film's subject as ‘quite daring’. He also reflected on the challenges of being a Pakistani artiste working in India. Pakistani actor and singer Ali Zafar made his Bollywood debut with Tera Bin Laden in 2010.

stories.title: Thane: Two youths killed in late-night collision with container truck
stories.summary: Two 18-year-olds were killed after a two-wheeler collided with a container truck on Retibandar Road along the Mumbra-Thane route late on Sunday, November 22. As per the officials, both victims were trapped beneath the container following the collision and were later declared dead at a hospital.

stories.summary: It was a starry evening at St Andrews last Sunday. This diarist found himself among quite the audience with Annu Agarwal, Tannishtha Chatterjee, Nimrat Kaur, and filmmaker Anant Mahadevan, all in attendance to catch Lillete Dubey and co in Mahesh Elkunchwar’s Autobiography.

stories.title: Mumbai: BMC Floats ₹16.6-Crore Tender For 2 Microtunnels Under Mahim Railway Tracks To Secure Water Supply
stories.summary: 6-crore project to strengthen Mumbai’s water supply network by laying new pipelines beneath railway tracks near Mahim station using microtunnelling technology. The civic body floated a tender on Thursday for constructing two underground passages, aimed at preventing future disruptions to water supply in G North and South wards.

stories.title: Panvel begins weekly water cuts in November, months ahead of summer
stories.summary: Summer is still months away, but Panvel residents are already being asked to brace for water scarcity. The Panvel Municipal Corporation (PMC) has begun weekly water cuts from Monday, leaving different parts of the city without municipal supply for 24 hours on designated days. The early rationing follows a below-average monsoon and concerns over dwindling dam stocks amid the ongoing El Nino effect.

stories.title: Eight rescued as fire breaks out in Mumbai Central building
stories.summary: Eight people, including an elderly woman and two toddlers, were rescued after a fire broke out in a residential building in Mumbai Central shortly after midnight on Sunday. A senior station officer of the Mumbai Fire Brigade (MFB) sustained a cut injury to his hand while battling the blaze.

stories.title: Central & Western Railway To Operate 3 Early-Morning Special Local Train For WNC Navy Half Marathon On
stories.summary: Mumbai: Western Railway (WR) and Central Railway (CR) will operate extra special slow suburban train service on Sunday, November 22, to facilitate smooth early-morning travel for runners participating in the Navy Half Marathon 2026, organised by the Western Naval Command.

stories.title: At Maharashtra UCC panel hearing, a call for gender-just law, not uniform
stories.summary: A panel headed by retired Supreme Court judge Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai, set up by the Maharashtra government to draft the Uniform Civil Code, will hold a two-day public hearing on November 21 and 22 to receive suggestions and opinions from citizens and stakeholder groups across the seven districts of the Konkan division.

stories.title: Buddy Bear tours Mumbai to mark 75 years of India-Germany diplomatic relations
stories.summary: It was grin and 'bear' it, as a sizeable 'Buddy Bear' banished the Monday morning blues for several Mumbaikars at the Gateway of India , Apollo Bunder, Monday morning. As part of the celebrations marking 75 years of diplomatic relations between India and Germany, the Consulate General of the Federal Republic of Germany in Mumbai presented ‘Buddy Bear’s Mumbai Adventures'.

stories.title: Mumbai veterinarians call for organised blood donor network to save dogs’ lives
stories.summary: From treating wildlife to caring for companion animals, veterinary expertise is increasingly bridging the gap between emergency care and life-saving treatment. Former wildlife veterinarian Dr Shailesh Pethe, who has worked with wild animals including leopards , is now focusing on strengthening transfusion care for dogs through MumbaiVet CritiCare Centre.

stories.title: Mumbai experiences coldest Nov in 8 years at 16°C, warmer days expected ahead
stories.summary: While temperatures as low as 16 degrees Celsius were recorded over the weekend, independent experts expect daytime maximum temperatures to remain slightly higher through the week. Official readings on the India Meteorological Department (IMD) website show that minimum temperatures at the Santacruz station are likely to hover between 19 degrees C and 20 degrees C over the coming week, while Colaba may record around 24 degrees C.

stories.title: Missing Powai boy found in Delhi after travelling alone to escape madrassa
stories.summary: Unwilling to return to his madrassa and fearing that his parents would force him to resume his studies, a 10-year-old boy from Powai travelled to Delhi, hoping to remain unrecognised in the national capital. After spending nearly two months away from home , the boy was eventually traced in Delhi’s RK Puram area after a group of children spotted him roaming around a garden and trying to play with them.

stories.title: Handwritten parking slips at Vikhroli station raise accountability concerns
stories.summary: Commuters parking their two-wheelers outside Vikhroli railway station raised concerns over the safety and accountability of the pay-and-park facility after the private contractor allegedly issued handwritten receipts instead of computer-generated slips. The receipts reportedly lacked essential details such as the day, date, time and vehicle registration number, leaving daily users questioning whether their vehicles would be accounted for in case of theft or damage.

stories.title: Mumbai: Dadar Beach residents raise concern over pigeon menace, urges BMC action
stories.summary: Residents around Dadar Beach have flagged the growing pigeon population and unchecked feeding, alleging that authorities are taking no action. Despite the prohibition on feeding pigeons, visitors continue to bring grains to the beach. Residents have urged the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) to step in and stop the activity.

stories.title: Unwind in Mumbai by embarking on a bar crawl around Bandra in a bus with the Dabombaes
stories.summary: If you decide to bar-hop across Bandra’s narrow, potholed lanes, there’s a good chance you’ll stumble even before your first drink, or watch your buzz wear off between never-ending signals. “There will be traffic, but that just means more time to have fun on the bus with new friends,” say Puja Vora and Mohit Bhatia of Dabombaes, who are inviting people aboard a bus, which is quite literally, made for a party.

stories.title: Will allow only BS-VI vehicles in Delhi, says Supreme Court amid winter pollution crisis
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Monday made it clear that only vehicles complying with BS-VI emission standards should be allowed to ply in Delhi during the pollution-prone winter months, even as it described the national capital’s relatively better air quality this November as a matter of good fortune, saying favourable winds had helped prevent the air quality from slipping into the severe category.

stories.title: Four children killed, 24 injured as truck rams school bus on UP's Agra-Lucknow expressway
stories.summary: Four schoolchildren were killed and 24 others, including school staff members, injured after a speeding truck rammed into a stationary school bus on the Agra-Lucknow Expressway in Uttar Pradesh's Kannauj district early Tuesday. The accident took place around 6 am near milestone 210, according to Kannauj police.

stories.title: Sanjay Raut accuses State Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar of tribal land grab
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Raut on Monday (November 23, 2026) has requested Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis to order an independent investigation into allegations accusing state assembly speaker Rahul Narwekar and his associates of illegally encroaching on land, evicting Katkari tribal families from their homes in Maharashtra’s Raigad district.

stories.title: Ranveer Singh hyped Deepika Padukone up during Tu Mil Jaaye shoot, made dance rehearsals fun, say King choreographers
stories.summary: In May this year, a video showing Ranveer Singh with his daughter Dua on the sets of King surfaced online, although his face was not visible. stories.summary: Kolhapur: Two people were killed after a four-wheeler hit their Activa scooter on the road between Shivaji University and Shahu Toll Plaza in Maharashtra's Kolhapur, police said. 45 pm on Monday. The victims have been identified as Umesh Vilas Patrod and Ganesh Sunil Patrod.

stories.title: Damian Hurley posts about Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando’s wedding
stories.summary: Damian Hurley was among the few close people who recently attended Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando's private wedding ceremony. stories.title: CBI Secures Deportation Of Haryana Murder Accused From Kazakhstan
stories.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has facilitated the return from Kazakhstan of an accused wanted by the Haryana Police in a 2025 murder case, said the agency on Monday (November 23, 2026). The accused, named Ashish Kumar, was tracked down to Almaty airport in Kazakhstan, following which he was detained and sent back to India.

stories.title: Three killed as car crosses divider, rams stationary truck in Wagholi | Hindustan Times

stories.title: Maharashtra sets up panel to revive sugar co-op sector
stories.summary: Concerned over the sharp decline in the number of operational sugar factories in the state, the Maharashtra government has constituted a panel to revitalise the cooperative sugar sector and suggest a financial model to sustain the industry. The 13-member panel will be headed by the sugar commissioner, Pune, and representatives from organisations working in the sugar cooperative sector.

stories.title: Delhi cop suspended after bride’s family alleges wedding called off over ₹13 lakh car demand; groom denies allegations
stories.summary: A Delhi Police constable has been suspended after the bride’s family accused him of demanding a costlier car as dowry and calling off their wedding in Sonipat, Haryana, officials said on Monday. The police constable has denied the allegations levelled against him. Constable Kuldeep, posted in the Outer North district, was placed under suspension with immediate effect, pending departmental action, news agency PTI cited a Delhi Police statement.

stories.title: IIT Bombay announces hostel safety upgrades after Sahil Wakode’s death
stories.summary: IIT Bombay has informed students that it will begin replacing existing fan rods in hostel rooms, starting with Hostel 4, as part of a broader set of measures to improve student safety and hostel infrastructure. stories.title: Earthquake in Nepal triggers tremors across north Bengal, Sikkim
stories.summary: 3-magnitude earthquake struck Nepal's Koshi province early on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), sending tremors across north Bengal and Sikkim, and triggering panic among residents. Officials said there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage in either the north Bengal districts of Darjeeling, Jalpaiguri and Cooch Behar, where the tremors were felt, or in Sikkim.

stories.title: Delhi pollution: AQI hits 200, Sirifort records 333 as Stage II GRAP remains in force
stories.summary: Delhi on Tuesday, November 24, woke up to another polluted morning, with the city's average Air Quality Index (AQI) at 200, according to real-time data from the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) . According to IANS, several monitoring stations across Delhi recorded poor air quality.

stories.title: Two attack man with axe after accidentally running over dog in Faridabad, arrested
stories.summary: Two suspects were arrested for allegedly attacking a man with an axe that left him critically injured following a petty dispute after the victim accidentally ran over a stray dog while reversing his car in Faridabad’s Sector-31, police said on Tuesday. The officials said that the suspects, identified as Rohtash and Dev, both residents of Faridabad, were arrested by the Sector 30 crime branch unit on Sunday.

stories.title: Rajat Dalal Warns Avinash Mishra To Stay Away From Eisha Singh Amid Breakup Row
stories.summary: The ongoing controversy surrounding television actors Eisha Singh and Avinash Mishra has taken another turn, with reality television personality Rajat Dalal publicly addressing the situation. Rajat, who shares a close bond with Eisha and considers her his younger sister, posted a video message on social media. In his message, Rajat also spoke about Avinash’s recent appearance at a club, where the actor was reportedly seen playing the song ‘Bewafa Nikli Hai Tu’.

stories.title: Cyber attack puts Haryana’s digital payments under scanner | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: A suspected cyberattack on the enterprise resource planning (ERP) software of Haryana’s development and panchayats department involving an unauthorised payment of about ₹ 75 lakh to an unknown vendor prompted the state government on Monday to issue stringent cybersecurity and financial security instructions to departments.

stories.title: Man jumps to death from Belapur court’s 5th floor minutes after receiving life sentence for sister’s murder
stories.summary: The deceased, Nagesh Lad, an autorickshaw driver from Nerul, had been lodged in the Taloja jail for the past seven years. Police commissioner Milind Bharambe said, “Technically, it’s a custodial death of the undertrial as he was in custody of police while being escorted to Taloja jail. ”On July 17, 2019, Lad stabbed to death his sister Sunita Singh (29) and injured his wife Jyotsna (23).

stories.title: ‘Severe explosions, fires’: Iran claims 3 oil tankers struck mines in Hormuz
stories.summary: Three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz in recent hours. Iranian military officials claimed these vessels were escorted by the US Navy while navigating the passage. According to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, US military support could not prevent these incidents from occurring.

stories.title: Collector files complaint against Kallakurichi TVK MLA
stories.summary: The Kallakurichi Collector has handed over a formal complaint to the Superintendent of Police against TVK MLA C. Arun Vignesh, sources said on Monday afternoon. It is learnt that the Collector had accused the MLA of having made inappropriate advances and sent unwarranted messages. The police are learnt to have registered the complaint against the MLA under the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act.

stories.title: What stands atop Thiruparankundram hill is a survey pillar, ascertains Tamil Nadu government report
stories.summary: A 2026 report compiled by the Departments of Survey and Settlement and Archaeology of the Tamil Nadu government ascertains that the pillar near the Sikandar Badusha Dargah in Thirupparankundram hill is a Great Trigonometrical Survey (GTS) pillar erected by the British. The map prepared by the Departments identifies the original Deepathoon (lamp pillar) to be below the dargah.

stories.title: NIA court frees 4 held for 2020 Srinagar terror attack that killed 2 soldiers
stories.summary: A special NIA court ruled that four men were not guilty of aiding terrorists in the 2020 attack. The prosecution could not establish any direct link between the men and the terrorists involved in the incident. Although two Army soldiers were killed, the evidence presented was circumstantial and insufficient.

stories.title: No Winter Session of Parliament? Skipped only four times in history
stories.summary: The Winter Session of Parliament has been skipped only four times in India’s parliamentary history, and each instance was linked to exceptional circumstances, including the Emergency, the premature dissolution of the Lok Sabha, the assassination of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, and the COVID-19 pandemic.

stories.title: BJP MLA Rekha Patra off ventilator after suspected herbal larvicide poisoning
stories.summary: Patra has started responding and is doing better than before, BJP leader Archana Das Majumdar said after she and West Bengal Health Minister Sharadwat Mukhopadhyay spoke to doctors. "Rekha is better than before. She has been taken off the ventilator," Mukhopadhyay told reporters.

stories.title: Maharashtra forms panel to frame SOPs for air ambulance services
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has constituted a seven-member committee to formulate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for air ambulance and new ambulance services across the state. The committee will examine various aspects of ambulance operations and recommend measures to ensure standardised procedures, safety and better coordination among the departments concerned.

stories.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
stories.summary: Anchored in a Mediterranean harbour nearly 2,000 miles from Moscow, the Captain of Russia's corvette Merkury might well have thought his ship was safe from attack. It wasn't.
